title: HtmlSearch
responsibility: Renders the native search element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSearch.attributes
inputs.description: Native search attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSearch.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native search element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSearch
outputs.description: The actual native search element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
